figurative_meaning_en: Something that melts in the heat
similar_in_english: Melts like butter in the sun
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ননীর পুতুলের মতো, একটু চাপেই গলে যায়।
এই পরিকল্পনা ননীর পুতুল, গরমে ধরলে শেষ হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is like a grandmother's doll; he melts under the slightest pressure.
This plan is a snowflake; it will melt in the heat of execution.
note: Refers to traditional wax or soft dolls made by grandmothers that melt easily, symbolizing vulnerability in Bengali folklore.
